source.author: verg
source.text: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat; et nunc aequali tecum pubesceret aevo.
source.text_original: sic oculos, sic ille manus, sic ora ferebat; / et nunc aequali tecum pubesceret aevo.'
source.text_english: So he had such eyes, such hands, such a face; and now he would be growing up with you at the same age.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: stabo insultans et ovantia contra ora manusque feram.
reuse.text_original: stabo insultans et ovantia contra / ora manusque feram.
reuse.text_english: I shall stand there jeering, and I shall raise my hands in defiance against the exultant faces and hands.
